insights.summary: CallRail is pitching same-day conversion sync to Google Ads, often with a lower quote.
insights.quote: Kyle: "A buddy of mine at another outfit swears CallRail syncs conversions to Google Ads same day. Ours lands the next morning, and when their rep called me last month the quote was lower than what we pay you. I don't know if it's apples to apples, but it's the one thing that got my attention."
